evidence.detail: rs/s/f/c stores only reviewed GroundMarkersConfig rs/s/f/b and GroundMarkersPlugin rs/s/f/d; the plugin supplies its live marker collection directly to the overlay.
Its render method iterates the plugin's ColorTileMarker collection, skips markers not on the current Client plane, resolves each marker's optional color/label, and renders that marker's world tile.
The overlay consumes the reviewed config's border width, fill opacity and default marker color, builds the tile polygon and draws optional marker labels using the shared overlay helpers.

The class extends the shared overlay base and has no state or behavior outside Ground Markers rendering; adjacent rs/s/f/e is only a Gson TypeToken<List<GroundMarkerPoint>> and is deliberately excluded.

proposals.note: GroundMarkersOverlay is fixed by exclusive GroundMarkersPlugin/Config ownership and a complete ColorTileMarker render loop. Confidence is 0.999; serialization TypeToken helpers remain unnamed.
